image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: educational hairstyle-analysis case image for a mobile app
Primary request: Create one seamless horizontal four-panel contact sheet showing the exact same fictional adult East Asian woman in her late 50s, photographed in a salon before any haircut or styling change. Panels, left to right: front view, true left profile, true right profile, true back view.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm light-gray salon wall, no mirrors, tools, logos or text.
Subject: same person, same natural expression, same charcoal crew-neck top, same upright neutral head position and shoulder level in every panel. Current hair is a grown-out collarbone-length salt-and-pepper bob/lob. Approximately half gray visually, with brighter silver concentrated around temples and front hairline, darker strands through crown and back. Top lies fairly quiet; maximum width sits from lower cheek to upper neck. Ends touch the shoulders and form a mixture of gentle inward and outward bends. Nape inner layer has a shallow natural wave. Hair is clean, air-dried, unretouched, with realistic flyaways and visible mixed shine; no salon blowout.
Style/medium: highly realistic smartphone documentary portrait photography, honest skin and hair texture, neutral color, no beauty filter, no fashion editorial polish.
Composition/framing: landscape contact sheet; every panel shows the complete top of head, full hairstyle outline and bottom line, neck and both shoulders. True orthographic-like front/profile/back documentation, matched camera distance and lens perspective. Keep facial identity, head/face proportions, hair length, gray distribution, clothing and lighting exactly consistent across all views.
Lighting/mood: soft even window-like daylight, low contrast, analytical and neutral.
Constraints: image shows only the current pre-service state; not a reference hairstyle, not a proposed cut, not a before/after, not a chemical service result. No labels, no arrows, no measurements, no watermark, no text. Do not infer or exaggerate age. Do not hide hair behind shoulders or crop the head, neckline, bottom line, or shoulders. Profiles must be genuine 90-degree side views and back view must show no face.
Avoid: split identities, inconsistent gray pattern, inconsistent length, glamour makeup, professional studio blur, dramatic lighting, retouching, wigs, overly white hair, curls, obvious perm, smiling teeth, jewelry, glasses, hats, hair clips, hands, extra people.
